pages.title: Crafting Spirit Glasses
pages.text: Right-click the glasses to equip them in the head slot.

pages.title: Finding a Grotto
pages.text: Stele grottoes generate sparsely below ground in the Overworld, averaging about one every 1,200 blocks. They only appear in newly generated chunks.$(br2)There is no artificial entrance; explore underground caves or dig into the surrounding rock.

pages.title: Ancient Stele
pages.text: Each grotto has a pool, central island, earth and moss layers, glow berries overhead, and a stele at its center.$(br2)The stele cannot be mined with a pickaxe. Wear Spirit Glasses to see its faint golden runes.
